// PROBE FIXTURE for tests/unit/profile-writes-single-path.test.ts.
// The shape of the onboarding flags and the notification ceiling: only
// `preferences` is written, and the spread is INSIDE the preferences blob.
// The guard must read both writes as fact-free — no applyFactWrites required.
import { db } from "@/lib/db"

export async function probePreferencesOnly(userId: string, preferences: Record<string, unknown>) {
    await db.policyholderProfile.upsert({
        where: { userId },
        create: { userId, preferences: { ...preferences, onboardingCompleted: true } },
        update: { preferences: { ...preferences, onboardingCompleted: true, showTour: true } },
    })
    await db.policyholderProfile.update({
        where: { userId },
        data: { preferences: { showTour: false } },
    })
}
